components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-contrast action on yellow or paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 13px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(63, 38, 24, 0.2); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(63, 38, 24, 0.28); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter companion action designed to sit directly on Sticker Sun.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; border: 2px solid rgba(63, 38, 24, 0.28); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Topic Chip
components.description: Compact in-page wayfinding presented on the floating paper sheet.
components.css: .ds-topic-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-topic-chip:hover { background: var(--sun-soft); } .ds-topic-chip:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-topic-chip:active { background: var(--sun); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: The compact header destination with a shared hover and current-page treatment.
components.html: SupportPrivacy
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: rgba(255, 203, 33, 0.44); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: FAQ Disclosure
components.description: A native expandable answer row with a circular yellow state marker.
components.html:
Does Duckmoji require an account?
No. Duckmoji has no account, sign-in, ads, tracking, networking, or in-app purchases.
components.css: .ds-faq { max-width: 700px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(63, 38, 24, 0.18); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); } .ds-faq summary { position: relative; padding: 1.35rem 3rem 1.35rem 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 720; list-style: none; } .ds-faq summary::after { position: absolute; top: 1.2rem; right: 0; display: grid; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sun); content: "+"; } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { content: "−"; } .ds-faq div { max-width: 70ch; padding: 0 3rem 1.5rem 0; color: var(--ink-soft); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Numbered Step
components.description: A flat instructional unit introduced by a circular Sticker Sun numeral.
components.html:
1

Open Stickers

Open a conversation, tap the plus button, then choose Stickers.
components.css: .ds-step { max-width: 320px; min-height: 250px; padding: 2rem 1.6rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); } .ds-step-number { display: grid; width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sun); font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-step h3 { margin: 0 0 0.55rem; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 740; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-step:focus-within { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Privacy Stamp
components.description: A lightly rotated proof mark for dated, trustworthy metadata.
components.css: .ds-privacy-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 760; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-privacy-stamp:hover { background: var(--sun-soft); } .ds-privacy-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Duckmoji support should feel like opening a cheerful sticker sheet, not entering a corporate help center. The system pairs sunny fields, warm cream paper, thick chocolate ink, and expressive shipping Duckmoji artwork with direct editorial structure. It is playful on sight and trustworthy in use.

Personality comes from scale, color, gentle asymmetry, and real sticker cutouts—not from decorative clutter. Oversized display type makes each promise immediate; ruled lists and generous reading measures make practical and privacy content calm. The result is warm, legible, fast, and suitable for an App Store-facing support destination.
keyCharacteristics: Bold sun-yellow fields against warm cream paper.
Oversized, tightly set editorial headlines with highly legible body copy.
Real Duckmoji cutouts used as expressive wayfinding and proof of character.
Rounded, high-contrast panels balanced by crisp chocolate rules.
Restrained lift, tactile states, and a single responsive mobile stack.

rules.name: The Sun Owns the Greeting Rule
rules.body: Use Sticker Sun for high-emotion brand moments and compact wayfinding marks; do not flood long reading surfaces with it.

rules.name: The No Generic Black Rule
rules.body: Chocolate Ink carries text, focus, rules, and dark surfaces so every high-contrast moment stays warm.

rules.name: The Big Feeling, Clear Reading Rule
rules.body: Let Bricolage make the emotional promise; hand every explanation to Atkinson Hyperlegible.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Display headings use compact line-height and negative tracking, while body copy stays open and uncompressed.

rules.name: The One Reading Rail Rule
rules.body: Practical content aligns to the same `960px` rail even when adjacent brand moments use the broader frame.

rules.name: The Paper, Ink, Sticker Rule
rules.body: Use ambient shadow for sheets, firm shadow for actions, and drop shadow for cutout artwork; never apply card shadow to ruled reading rows.

rules.name: The Scale With Importance Rule
rules.body: Larger radii belong to larger brand fields; compact controls stay tighter so the interface remains deliberate rather than bubbly.

dos: Do lead major moments with Sticker Sun, Chocolate Ink, and a real Duckmoji cutout.
Do keep instructions and policy copy on warm, quiet paper with generous reading measures.
Do use thick display type for promises and Atkinson Hyperlegible for every explanatory passage.
Do preserve visible four-pixel keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do collapse multi-column structures into one clear mobile stack at `760px`.
donts: Don't turn the public site into a generic blue-and-white corporate help center.
Don't substitute stock illustration, emoji, or abstract mascot shapes for real Duckmoji artwork.
Don't add shadow to every row; rules and tonal contrast carry most structure.
Don't introduce tiny legal copy, dense card grids, hidden mobile navigation, or low-contrast controls.
Don't crop sticker art into rectangular thumbnails or let decoration obscure practical content.
